visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown curly hair and a black face mask stands in the foreground, speaking directly into a handheld microphone. He is wearing a bright blue puffer jacket with a white fleece collar. Behind him, a blurred outdoor environment with trees and other protesters is visible. (2) The camera pans to show a large crowd of people gathered on a city street lined with parked cars. Several protesters are holding signs and banners. A woman in a blue Adidas cap and a white hoodie is being interviewed, holding a small microphone near her face while speaking emotionally. (3) A close-up view of a black banner with red Chinese characters being held by a protester in a black beanie. In the background, a white transport bus with 'Taiwan Taipei District Court' printed on its side drives slowly past a line of police officers in high-visibility vests. (4) The video transitions to a split-screen collage showing four photos of a young child, juxtaposing images of the child looking healthy and happy with images showing severe injuries and medical treatment. This is followed by a detailed text-heavy infographic listing specific physical abuses. (5) A series of illustrations concludes the video: first, a black and white drawing of a child lying on the ground surrounded by demonic shadows, then a colored comic style depiction of two sinister elderly women with exaggerated, menacing expressions and red eyes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with a moderate, slightly urgent tone, characterized by clear articulation and neutral pitch. Background noise consists of muffled city ambience and distant chatter. No background music is present during this initial vocal segment. (2) The soundscape shifts to a loud, rhythmic collective chanting of a four-syllable Mandarin phrase, showing high vocal arousal. The chanting is accompanied by the sound of a vehicle engine idling and people shuffling in a crowded outdoor space. (3) An emotional female voice takes over, speaking with noticeable vocal strain and breathiness, indicating distress. The pitch is higher than the previous speaker, and her speech rate slows down significantly during pauses, punctuated by the faint sounds of wind hitting the microphone. (4) The rhythmic chanting returns at a higher volume as the narrator asks for video shares. This is followed by the sound of a vehicle door closing and tires rolling on pavement as a bus moves past. (5) A somber, slow-tempo piano melody begins to play, featuring soft, singular notes with a dark, warm spectral centroid. This music continues through a series of silence-heavy vocal segments that list specific injuries, creating a dramatic and mournful atmosphere.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To report on a protest regarding a high-profile child abuse case in Taiwan, calling for strict legal action and the death penalty for the perpetrators while demanding justice for the victim.
